response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_margin FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate;

assumptions.assumption: Each group's rate is its total file size divided by its total scan duration. Only scans with both values recorded contribute; a group with zero total duration has no calculable rate.

alternatives.interpretation: Each group's rate is the average of its individual scans' GB-per-minute rates.
